name: more-tab-actions

scripts.e2e: node e2e/groups.mjs && node e2e/options.mjs && node e2e/toolbar.mjs
scripts.package: npm test && npm run check-ui && rm -rf release && mkdir release && zip -r -X release/more-tab-actions.zip manifest.json background.js actions.js settings.js migrate.js about-links.js sites.js undo.js recent.js shortcuts.js options.html chrome-ui.css options.css options.js toolbar-scheme.js toolbar-theme.js offscreen.html offscreen.js icons -x 'icons/toolbar/*.svg' && node scripts/warn-placeholder-links.mjs

description: Adds more actions to Chrome’s tab right-click menu.
